import subprocess

# Test 3: split with nonzero maxsplit - should work as before
code = r'''
from boltons.iterutils import split

# Basic split
result = split(['hi', 'hello', None, None, 'sup', None, 'soap', None])
print("Basic:", result)
assert result == [['hi', 'hello'], ['sup'], ['soap']]

# With maxsplit=1
result = split([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], sep=3, maxsplit=1)
print("maxsplit=1:", result)
assert result == [[1, 2], [4, 5]]

# With maxsplit=2
result = split([1, 2, 3, 4, 3, 5], sep=3, maxsplit=2)
print("maxsplit=2:", result)
assert result == [[1, 2], [4], [5]]

print("PASS: all existing behaviors preserved")
'''
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-c', code], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
print(result.stdout)
